verdict.rationale: Weaviate's backup docs describe backing up an entire instance or only selected collections, and restoring them. Backups can target S3, GCS or Azure blob storage, restores can move between different storage providers, and incremental backups store only changed data. That covers the core of the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that backup and restore work as described, and explicit detail on restoring individual collections and on snapshot consistency semantics.
